spatial_context.note: Full 11QC dimer with bound crop graft used ONLY for accessibility; observed glycans and 10A anchor/cut buffers are incomplete glycan coverage. Native-contact positions are exempt from low-total-SASA exclusion alone, never from crop/glycan/excess-exposure exclusions.

scope: Bounded His variants on three confirmed apical parents; A41H comparison

screen.replicates: ONE seed/sample; screening only, not a qualified parent
screen.controls: 2DS25.5 selected model must recover fold<=2A, native-contact recall>=0.5, interface pose<=2A, ipTM>=0.5 in both seeds; presumed negatives must not reach 0.5 interface ipTM in selected models
screen.families: Exploratory complete-link clustering: >=30% identity OR equal-length self-fit CA RMSD<=3A joins a family; inspect before any expansion
screen.decision: Cost/quality checkpoint after 200. No automatic expansion. Shortlist at most 30 diverse leads for deep evaluation.
screen.limits: Self-consistency is not binding validation. Low-score exclusions are not demonstrated nonbinders. No affinity or pH claims. Mouse compatibility remains untested.
screen.ranking: Within binder class: geometry eligibility first, then equal-weight percentile ranks of interface ipTM descending, contact-pair PAE ascending, hotspot fraction descending, binder fold RMSD ascending. Sequence diversity selection at 80% identity; preserve epitope representation.
screen.nanobody_confidence: Record ipTM>=0.5 as descriptive only; no validated positive VHH control on this target.
screen.control_policy: One-sample matched 2DS25.5 plus presumed negatives; fail blocks advancement, does not trigger automatic reruns.

selection_rule.alignment: Rigid least-squares fit using all 194 corresponding target C-alpha atoms; no binder atoms
selection_rule.completeness: Exact target sequence and all 194 finite target CA coordinates required
selection_rule.ranking: Among eligible samples, maximize 0.8*ipTM + 0.2*pTM; tie -> lowest sample index
selection_rule.no_eligible_samples: Case fails; no fallback to a rejected sample
selection_rule.scope: Identical rule for positive, negative and novel cases; no binder geometry or epitope used for selection
selection_rule.rationale: Target distortion made global-frame pose validation unreliable in a previous control. The 2 A scale matches the existing structural-screen tolerance; this is a new heuristic, not a validated physical boundary.

structural_preparation.method: Amber14/GBn2; fixed receptor; binder backbone restrained at 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2
structural_preparation.policy: Apply to every selected candidate and control, irrespective of raw outcome. Preserve raw decisions; no alternate sample or repeat relaxation after failure. Prepared evidence is a separate prospective diagnostic, not retrospective qualification.

cases.note: Published positive or presumed negative; never a novel candidate

site_policy.high_contact_anchor: Exclude residues in the top 20% by buried SASA AND contact atom-pair count among contacting residues in either source pose. Geometric proxy, not energy.
site_policy.strata: Prefer up to three peripheral sites (buried SASA <=65 in both poses) and two partially buried sites (>65 in either pose); fill vacancies by worst-pose 3*basic_atoms-oxygen_atoms.
site_policy.pair_policy: At most three pairs, CA separation 5-16 A in both poses; rank summed worst-pose site heuristic, lexical tie break.

prospective_plan.confirmation: Require all selected structural controls to pass; at most two new passing variants per parent by selected interface ipTM descending, lexical tie break. Keep all three parents and both A41H comparison sequences. No substitute samples or seed retries.
prospective_plan.direction: Both selected fresh-seed mutant models and controls must pass raw checks; same frozen preparation and strict direction criteria as prior round. Report matched-parent eligibility separately.
